Equivalent fresh initial business state and identical request order; both copies now contain bounded processing writes.

Small batch observation does not qualify official congestion performance or change original failure.

Separate post-workload observations warm caches and do not enter client timings.

Plans strip query text, parameter literals, identifiers and conditions.
Memory/temp I/O fields are recorded only when PostgreSQL exposes them; missing does not prove zero memory or no spill.
